insights.heading: Insights
insights.body: Views, feedback and searches with no results arrive with article feedback and view counts (M5-08).

tree.heading: Structure
tree.footnote: Drag a handle, or focus it and press Arrow up or Arrow down. The order here is the order on the help center.
tree.readOnly: The order here is the order on the help center.

dialog.body: Name it in one language or both. A missing name shows the other language's.

toast.failed: That did not work. Try again.

status.archived: Archived. Visitors see that it is gone.

visibility.public: Now public. Search and sitemap update within 60 s.
visibility.internal: Now internal. Search and sitemap update within 60 s.

toast.imported: Markdown imported. It saves in a moment.

refusals.slug-taken: Another article already uses that address.
refusals.not-empty: Move or delete what is inside it first.
refusals.was-published: This article has been published. Archive it instead.
refusals.schedule-in-past: Choose a time in the future.
refusals.limit-reached: This help center already has as many of these as it can keep.

empty.heading: No articles here yet
empty.body: Write the first article for this section. It stays a draft until you publish it.

list.label: Articles
list.footnote: A dashed language chip means that translation does not exist; visitors in that language get the brand's default language. Internal articles show only to signed-in staff and never reach public search, the sitemap or the widget.

confirm.title: Delete "{{title}}"?
confirm.body: Only an article that was never published can be deleted. A published one is archived instead.

settings.heading: Who can read it
settings.body: Applies to every article in this help center.

public.label: Public
public.hint: Anyone can read public articles. Each article can still be marked internal.

internal_only.label: Internal only
internal_only.hint: Signed-in staff only. Every article becomes internal, the sitemap is emptied, pages are never cached publicly and the widget cannot show articles. Takes effect within 60 s.

settings.saved: Saved. It takes effect within 60 s.

editor.notFound: This article could not be opened.
editor.pasteHint: Paste an image: saved as WebP
editor.imageRejected: That image could not be used. Try a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
editor.title: Title
editor.linkBody: A web address, an email or phone link, a #anchor in this article or a path on this help center.
editor.linkInvalid: That is not an address a link can use.

video.label: Video:
video.title: Embed a video
video.body: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo address. The help center shows the player.
video.invalid: Only YouTube and Vimeo videos can be embedded.

language.heading: Language
language.missing: There is no {{language}} version yet. Type a title to start one; until it is published, {{language}} visitors get {{fallback}}.

visibility.heading: Visibility
visibility.note: Search and sitemap update within 60 s.

address.heading: Address and search
address.slugInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.

activity.heading: Activity
activity.auditLog: All changes in the audit log
